text_block_list.text: —The day of the Queen Elizabeth II Cup.

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
"Man, today's star of the show has gotta 
be Daiwa Scarlet, no question!"

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
I know. Vodka couldn't make it due to 
injury, after all. I want her to do her 
best in her stead too.

text_block_list.name: Madam Wearing a Hat
text_block_list.text:
An exceptional Umamusume truly worthy of 
the Queen's crown has appeared this 
year...! Hohoho, I certainly hope she 
emerges victorious.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
"...Does wearing a crown truly make one a 
princess?"

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
If I am blessed and acknowledged by 
everyone, would I be able to become one?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
No, it is because I keep challenging 
myself. Because I keep fighting for my own 
sake. That is how I can become the ideal 
princess.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
No matter where I find myself, I will walk 
the path true to who I am.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Even if they say what lies ahead 'isn't a 
princess,' to me, she'll always be my 
'princess.'
choice_data_list:
That path will surely become a guidepost 
for someone else too.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: ...Yes.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Ever unyielding, noble, and strong! I 
shall gracefully blow you all away!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
And now, the Queen Elizabeth II Cup! The 
Scarlet Queen, Daiwa Scarlet, fresh off 
two tiara crowns, enters the fray!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Can she avenge her comrade-in-arms, 
Vodka?! Expectations are high for a great 
run!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
I'm looking forward to today, 
Kawakami-san!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Likewise! I am positively thrilled to go 
all-out against such a magnificent 
opponent!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
Who will be crowned this year's queen?! 
Scarlet Queen! Don't you dare lose, for 
Vodka's sake too!!

text_block_list.name: Madam Wearing a Hat
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Madame! You're finally here!? This 
year's candidate is truly queenly! Look, 
the seat next to me is open, so...

text_block_list.name: Lady in a Dress
text_block_list.text:
No, I'm here with my son and his friends 
today. I appreciate the invitation, but...

text_block_list.name: Madam Wearing a Hat
text_block_list.text:
Oh, is that so? What a shame. But even if 
we're in different places, let's both 
cheer on the Scarlet Queen together!

text_block_list.name: Tanned Boy
text_block_list.text: Mooom! Hurry, hurry! It's gonna staaart!

text_block_list.name: Lady in a Dress
text_block_list.text:
Wait a sec, Kai-kun. I'm coming now. 
...Alright, up we go.

text_block_list.name: Lady in a Dress
text_block_list.text:
...I hope that princess gets to become 
queen.

text_block_list.name: Tanned Boy
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, Mom! Make sure to watch! Kawakami 
Princess's running is seriously amazing!

text_block_list.name: Tanned Boy
text_block_list.text:
'Cause you're the strongest princess... 
that I've always looked up to!
